messages:
jess: FYI — after yesterday's rate-policy bump some customers hit 401s and 429s. Saw it first from ACME corp's integration. example response snippet:

jess: ```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
x-request-id: req_abc123
x-rate-policy: v2-burst
content-type: application/json
{"error":"token invalid","code":401}
```

jess: repro: curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxx' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate

tyler: looking — is this only after policy activation in us-west-2 canary?

nina: any correlation with quota window or burst window? logs + trace id please

jess: trace req_abc123 attached below (log excerpt):

jess: "auth: token validated -> policy attach v2-burst -> policy eval -> fail: rate_decision=deny tenant=acme"

simon: ACME says they started a big batch job at 02:30 UTC, maybe simultaneous token rotation

tyler: hypothesis: new policy has stricter auth header parse that rejects rotated tokens; fallback not triggered because policy metadata mismatch. Plan: 1) temporarily route acme to policy v1-legacy via routing rule, 2) rollback v2-burst from canary -> hold. Anyone object?

nina: +1, need to ensure cache invalidation for KV token cache when we flip routing. Otherwise they'll still see 401.

jess: how do we flip routing? can you post the command I can run with support perms

tyler: run:

tyler: ```bash
redwoodctl routing set --tenant acme --policy v1-legacy --from canary-2026-02
```

tyler: then run `redwoodctl deploy rollback --policy v2-burst --scope canary-2026-02`

deploy-bot: Deploy started by tyler: rollback policy v2-burst (canary-2026-02). job=deploy-8823

nina: after you flip routing, purge kv cache for tenant:

nina: ```bash
redwoodctl cache purge --tenant acme --type token-kv
```

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: rollback complete. job=deploy-8823 status=ok

jess: routing flip + cache purge done. ACME confirms traffic is green. Thanks.

marie: can we draft a short customer note and add to status page? they'll want explanation and timeline

simon: i'll file a billing note in case they saw failed billing calls

tyler: postmortem owners: nina + tyler + jess. Let's capture root cause and safer rollout gating (auto fallback when auth mismatch).

jess: ack — will start a thread in #postmortems with initial repro and logs

nina: marking as resolved in our tracker. :white_check_mark:
